title: Customer Per-Diem Share by Purchase Program — Trade-In Agreements
content:
Under **Trade-In Agreements**, the share of the remaining payoff per diem charged to the customer depends on the vehicle program of the purchase order the trade is applied to, as that order shows it under **Vehicle Purchase Agreements**.

| Vehicle program of the purchase the trade is applied to | Customer share of the remaining per diem |
|---|---|
| Kestrel Premium Certified | 0 (none of it) |
| Kestrel Factory Certified | 0 (none of it) |
| Kestrel Certified | 0.5 (half) |
| Kestrel Certified Plus | 0.5 (half) |
| Any other program | All of it |

The payoff charge then carries the quote amount plus the quote's per diem multiplied by the customer's per-diem days and by this share; it is rounded to the nearest cent only once, at the end.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

Quote amount $11200.00, per diem $4.20, customer's per-diem days 3.

| Program of the linked purchase | Per diem charged | Payoff charge |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Factory Certified | $0.00 | $11200.00 |
| Kestrel Certified | $6.30 | $11206.30 |
| Any other program | $12.60 | $11212.60 |
